limitations: Name-based selector detection is conservative and may flag unrelated Rename methods.
Source scanning is not type, call-graph or physical safety proof.
Bare helper calls, wrappers, reflection/dynamic calls and future APIs require behavioral review.
Exact first-line manual-tag exemption does not prove an environment gate or safe function body. These two functions were checked independently.
Go unit/race tests, actual target listing and foreign compile-symbol checks remain NOT_RUN for this review.
